Container.Name: onetv-server
Container.Overview: TV recording server for OneTV Connect (iPhone, iPad, Apple TV, Mac). Schedule recordings from the app; this server records them to your array, even when your devices are off. Included with OneTV Connect Pro. No setup: the apps find the server on your network and pair by themselves. Away from home the apps reach your recordings through the OneTV relay or a direct encrypted connection: nothing to open or forward on your router. WebUI: see and manage recordings in progress (programme, size, recording time) and stop them.

Config.Name: Recordings
Config.Description: Folder where the recordings are written.

Config.Name: Web page port
Config.Description: Management page for your home network (WebUI): recordings in progress, stop, upcoming, finished. 0 turns it off.
